tagline: Designing, manufacturing and marketing solutions that help create a cleaner, safer, healthier world
hero_kpi_rationale: No distinctive wow factor identified. The technology sector expects strong innovation engagement, but TNC operates in mechanized industrial cleaning without significant AI or cloud leverage. R&D is retained as an innovation proxy in a context of limited transformation.

kpis.name: Net revenue
kpis.explanation: Money earned from the sale of products and services.
kpis.description: Revenue declined in 2025, impacted by ERP disruptions in North America and a challenging macroeconomic environment, particularly in China and EMEA.
kpis.signal: Organic decline linked to ERP and macro

kpis.name: Gross margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue remaining after production costs.
kpis.description: Gross margin contracted in 2025 due to targeted inflationary pressures, tariffs, and operational inefficiencies related to ERP implementation.
kpis.signal: Margin compression from inflation and ERP

kpis.name: Operating margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit relative to total revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin of 5.7% in 2025 ($68.3M / $1,203.5M), down 3.2 pts from 8.9% in 2024 ($114.3M / $1,286.7M), reflecting the impact of ERP inefficiencies and inflationary pressures.

kpis.name: R&D investment (percentage of revenue)
kpis.explanation: Money spent on innovation, relative to sales.
kpis.description: R&D spending maintained at 3.4% of revenue, consistent with 2024. Low level compared to tech sector (15-25%), but typical for mechanical industry.
kpis.signal: R&D stable but low vs tech

kpis.name: Capital expenditures
kpis.explanation: Money invested in plants, machinery, and software.

kpis.explanation: Operational disruptions related to the new ERP system launch.

risks.title: Economic risk

risks.title: Competition risk

risks.title: Regulatory risk
